_note: Per-map meeting questions and common-lie notes, from the research digest (relay game-knowledge.md section 4, 2026-10-22) plus the map data. Selected by src/engine/mapQuestions.ts. `when` fields (bodyRoom, claimRoom, claimTask, sabotage, claimMonitor = admin|cams|vitals|doorLog) are ANDed; a list means any of these; an empty `when` applies to every meeting on that map (questions only - lies always need a matching condition). Placeholders: {P} speaker/target player, {V} victim, {R} claimed room, {B} body room, {TASK} claimed task. An entry whose placeholders cannot be filled is skipped. `weight` 0..1 = how useful the question usually is (tactics judgement, not measured). Every room / task / sabotage id here is checked by src/data/maps/questions.test.ts.

questions.text: {P} you said elec. Did you see anyone leave through storage?
questions.why: Electrical is a dead end: the only walking exit is Storage (vent to MedBay / Security aside).

questions.text: {P} where did you download? Upload is always admin.
questions.why: Skeld uploads only in Admin; downloads in Cafeteria, Comms, Electrical, Navigation, Weapons.

questions.text: Who was on cams? Who walked the medbay hall?
questions.why: A camera covers the MedBay / Upper Engine hallway.

questions.text: {P} which wires? Wires go elec storage admin nav cafe sec.
questions.why: Fix Wiring panels are always done in this order; a wrong order is a fake.

questions.text: {P} nav has two vents. Who came out of shields or weps?
questions.why: Navigation vents link to Weapons (upper) and Shields (lower).

questions.text: {P} you did card in admin. Card is common. Who else has it?
questions.why: Swipe Card is a common task: everyone has it or nobody does.

questions.text: Who fixed O2 in admin and who in O2?
questions.why: O2 is fixed at two keypads (Admin and O2); fixers are alibied for the fix moment.

questions.text: {P} reactor to security takes seconds. Where were you?
questions.why: Reactor, Security and both engines are a few seconds apart, and Reactor vents to both engines.

lies.text: The Divert Power panel in Reactor is a dummy — nobody can do it.
Nobody downloads in Admin on Skeld — Admin is the upload stage only.

questions.text: Who checked doorlog? Who crossed the north sensor?
questions.why: The Doorlog in Communications lists living players crossing the three Hallway sensors.

questions.text: {P} you came from launchpad. Doorlog would show you.
questions.why: From Launchpad to the top rooms or Cafeteria you must cross a Hallway sensor (unless you vent).

questions.text: {P} asteroids is not visual on Mira. That clears nobody.
questions.why: On MIRA HQ only Submit Scan is visual.

questions.text: Who fixed O2 in greenhouse and who by medbay?
questions.why: O2 keypads are in Greenhouse and the corridor south of Locker Room.

questions.text: {P} you went through decon. Who was behind you?
questions.why: Decontamination is slow (doors + spray); people queue and see each other.

questions.text: Lights are fixed in office here. {P} where were you?
questions.why: MIRA lights are fixed in Office, not Electrical.

questions.text: {P} which admin task? Id code is common.
questions.why: Enter Id Code (Admin) is common: everyone has it or nobody does.

questions.text: {P} every vent on Mira connects. Far away is not an alibi. Who saw you?
questions.why: MIRA HQ has one vent system: any vent room reaches any other in seconds.

lies.text: {TASK} is not a visual task on MIRA HQ — "watch me do it" proves nothing.
MIRA HQ has no cameras and no vitals — "I saw it on cams" is made up.

questions.text: Who checked vitals? When did {V} go DED?
questions.why: Vitals in Office: DED = killed since the last meeting.

questions.text: {P} which weather node? Then lab?
questions.why: Weather node stage 1 is at a named outdoor node, stage 2 in Laboratory.

questions.text: {P} you were in elec with doors shut. Who let you out?
questions.why: Polus doors stay shut until someone flips the switches.

questions.text: {P} insert keys is in dropship. Everyone has it if it is common.
questions.why: Insert Keys is a common task in Dropship.

questions.text: {P} upload on Polus is in comms. Where did you download?
questions.why: Polus downloads in Electrical, O2, Office, Specimen or Weapons; uploads in Communications.

questions.text: Who was on cams? Did anyone pass the lab camera?
questions.why: A camera watches the outside of Laboratory.

questions.text: {P} specimen is behind decon. Who saw you go in?
questions.why: Specimen is only reachable through a decontamination corridor.

lies.text: Polus has no Reactor room — Start Reactor is in Specimen Room.
Empty Garbage is not visual on Polus.

questions.text: {P} where did you spawn? Then where did you go?
questions.why: Everyone picks a spawn after a meeting; the first room + route is checkable.

questions.text: {P} you crossed gap room. Platform or the long way?
questions.why: Crossing Gap Room without the platform or the long route means venting (the two Gap Room vents connect).

questions.text: Who was on vitals? When did {V} die?
questions.why: Vitals in Medical.

questions.text: {P} wiring in {R} is fake. Which panel?
questions.why: The Fix Wiring panels in Armory, Communications and Vault are dummies.

questions.text: {P} which ladder did you take? We heard one.
questions.why: Ladder sounds are heard map-wide.

questions.text: Admin in records or cockpit. Did anyone check it?
questions.why: Two Admin tables: Cockpit and Records.

questions.text: {P} you said electrical. Which room of the maze?
questions.why: Electrical is a maze of small rooms; a vague answer is a tell.

lies.text: The Airship has no visual tasks — nobody can be cleared by watching {TASK}.
Meeting Room has one way in: the ladder from Gap Room (and it is on a camera).
The bin in Lounge is a dummy — Empty Garbage can't be done there.

questions.text: {P} did you zip or walk from storage?
questions.why: The zipline joins Storage and Communications.

questions.text: Who was on binoculars? Who was in the jungle?
questions.why: Lookout binoculars survey Beach and Jungle (not The Cliffs), even during Comms.

questions.text: {P} that was during mixup. Are you sure of the colour?
questions.why: Mushroom Mixup randomises colours and hides names for ~10 s.

questions.text: Who checked vitals in lab? When did {V} die?
questions.why: Vitals in Laboratory.

questions.text: {P} marshmallow is common. Did everyone get it?
questions.why: Roast Marshmallow is a common task.

questions.text: {P} you came down the cliff ladder. Who was up there?
questions.why: The cliffs are reached by ladders from the Jungle (or the zipline / ladder from Communications).

lies.text: Fix Wiring is a SHORT task on The Fungle, not common — "we all have wires" is false.
The Fungle has no Admin table — "I saw it on admin" is made up.
The Fungle has no visual tasks — watching {TASK} clears nobody.
